about: [O3] the walk-over arrest, the fists: a man punched before a beat cop; I wait for him and punch him - the fist fight (lane O4's crowd brawl, COP), played by O4's bot with a first-timer's hands (bad); won: he lies there, HEAT 2, his gun on the pavement, taken with E.

steps.eval: (G.people.hands.hasGun = false, 'staged: out of the station, no gun')

JSON.stringify({ fa: G.police.fists.active, who: window.__o3c.mode, down: window.__o3c.down, res: G.crowd.result, cmode: G.controller.mode, heat: G.police.heat, beat: G.scenes.beat, fail: G.lastFail, ev: G.police.events.slice(-6) })

steps.expect: G.lastFail ? G.lastFail.why.startsWith('Arrested.') && G.scenes.beat === 'station' : (window.__o3c && window.__o3c.down && G.police.heat >= 2 && G.controller.mode === 'walk')
steps.label: the fight ends: won (he lies there, HEAT 2: a cop down) or lost (arrested)

steps.walk: G.lastFail ? [[G.eye.x, G.eye.z]] : (() => { const I = G.stage.part('items').list.filter(i => i.dropped && i.kind === 'weapon' && !i.taken).slice(-1)[0]; return [[I.x + 0.9, I.z]]; })()

steps.look: G.lastFail ? [0, 0] : (() => { const I = G.stage.part('items').list.filter(i => i.dropped && i.kind === 'weapon' && !i.taken).slice(-1)[0]; const C = G.controller; const want = Math.atan2(-(I.x - G.eye.x), -(I.z - G.eye.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / 0.0021), Math.round(-(-0.9 - C.pitch) / 0.0021)]; })()

steps.label: won: his gun taken from the pavement (E)
